newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson sees HK$24 bln net revenue to FY99. [CORRECTED 09:38 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Henderson sees HK$24 bln net revenue to FY99. [CORRECTED 09:38 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to "net revenue" from "profit" in headline and text).
Henderson Land Development Co Ltd expects HK$24.2 billion net revenue (corrects) from residential property sales in the New Territories in the three fiscal years to 1999, its annual report said.

Henderson Land's annual report said the group is expected to book most of the HK$24.2 billion in estimated net revenue from sale of residential properties at Metro City in stages over fiscal years 1997, 1998 and 1999.
The annual report said Henderson Land has five commercial and residential development projects and one industrial development under pre-sale in Hong Kong.
These projects include Dragon Court and Silver Mansion on Hong Kong Island, Welland Plaza and Winning Centre in Kowloon, and The Tolo Place and Metro City in the New Territories.

Henderson Land group deputy general manager Colin Lam said the company had spent about HK$1 billion over the first nine months of the year on construction site acquisitions, contributing to a gross floor area of 800,000 sq. ft.
Lam said proceeds from Henderson's recent HK$3.5 billion share placement had been used for construction site purchases.
"Proceeds raised from our share placement, which are relatively small compared with our investments, have been reinvested to purchase construction sites," he said.
Henderson Land said in its annual report the group had a total development land bank in Hong Kong for the year ended June 30, 1996, of 24.2 million sq. ft. in total attributable gross floor area.
The group also holds a portfolio of agricultural land of about 13.4 million sq. ft in attributable land area spread over various districts in the New Territories in Hong Kong.
